item.name: Keys
item.usedFor: Weapons, shop items, wrap boxes, capsules, packs, daily shop refreshes, winstreak recovery
item.cardSummary: The everything-currency, earned from contracts, tasks, codes, and bundles. Most of your Keys should go to weapon unlocks first, since cosmetics come and go but the arsenal is forever.

item.name: Skin Tickets
item.usedFor: Skin Cases and certain daily shop skins
item.cardSummary: The free route to weapon skins, earned mainly through the Season Pass. They let you open Skin Cases without touching Robux.

item.name: Glory
item.usedFor: Ranked Shop cosmetics and weapon reward tracks
item.cardSummary: The competitive payout: earned from ranked season results based on ELO and wins, and spent on Glorious wraps, finishers, and skins that advertise your ladder record.

item.name: Jump Shard
item.cardSummary: A one-purpose collectible: gather enough and the Jump Pad utility is yours.

item.name: Candy
item.usedFor: Haunted Chest and spooky event shop items
item.cardSummary: The Halloween event currency. Earn it during spooky events and spend it before the event closes, because it retires with the season.

item.name: Crystals
item.usedFor: Jolly Chest, Festive Wrap Boxes, and festive shop items
item.cardSummary: The winter event currency, feeding the Jolly Chest and Festive Wrap Boxes during festive seasons.

item.name: Pearls
item.usedFor: Tropical Chest and summer event shop items
item.cardSummary: The summer event currency, spent on the Tropical Chest and beach-themed shop stock.
